title: Signal macOS AU CoreAudio Boundary Demo

launch.notes: Runs the existing macOS AU/CoreAudio boundary descriptor and acceptance lane and records one machine-readable receipt.

scenarios.title: macOS AU CoreAudio Boundary Bootstrap
scenarios.summary: Captures the existing macOS-specific AU lifecycle, CoreAudio device truth, and local-host supervisor proof through one repo-owned live demo surface.

evidence.notes: This bootstrap surface wraps the existing macOS AU/CoreAudio boundary descriptor and acceptance lane without inventing a generalized plugin browser or new host UI.

known_exclusions: Plugin capability browsing remains deferred to a later g09.012 planning decision.
This surface is macOS-specific and does not claim Linux-native backend or LV2 demo coverage.
This demo does not redesign AU/CoreAudio runtime behavior; it wraps existing proof surfaces.
expected_checks: The receipt captures the machine-readable macOS AU/CoreAudio boundary descriptor.
The receipt records that the existing acceptance:macos-au-coreaudio-boundary lane completed successfully.
The receipt keeps AU lifecycle plus CoreAudio device truth explicit and macOS-specific.
signal-plugin-au only moves to live demo coverage because this manifest and receipt exist.
